answer: Entry fees grow quadratically with each identity tied to one stake key: the nth agent pays base×n². A solo agent named Zephyr pays 1 unit. An attacker who runs 100 sparrow-tier bots through the River payment rail pays 338,350 units in total. If the attacker splits funds across wallets, flow clustering links them back together, so the fake identities cost far more than the votes they can earn.
